promises.quote: Overall, our long-term aspiration remains unchanged, continues to be 26% to 28%.

reported.quote: Revenue for the quarter was ₹73,188 crore.
In constant currency, revenue grew 0.5% sequentially and 2.8% year-on-year.
International revenue grew 1.2% sequentially in constant currency.
TCV for the quarter was US$9.6 billion.
Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion and crossed 10% of our overall revenue.
Our quarterly revenue was ₹73,188 crore, a growth of 1.3% sequentially and 11.2% on a year-on-year basis.
Our operating margins remained stable sequentially at 24%.
Our net margins for the quarter were 19%.
DSO stood at 74 days, constant sequentially in dollar terms.
Our cash conversion remains strong at 102.2% of net income and funds invested at the end of the period stood at $5.98 billion.
This quarter, we continue to invest in future-ready talent, onboarding top talent globally, taking our workforce to 598,056 associates.
LTM attrition in IT services reduced by 30 basis points sequentially to 13.3%.
